# Erdos.p1084 — Erdős problem 1084

Reference: https://www.erdosproblems.com/1084
Imported from google-deepmind/formal-conjectures (`ErdosProblems/1084.lean`, theorem `erdos_1084.variants.triangular_optimal_d2`, AMS 52).

Erdős conjectured that the triangular lattice is best possible in 2D, in particular that
$f_2(3n^2 + 3n + 1) < 9n^2 + 3n$.

Note: in [Er75f] is read $9n^2 + 6n$, but this seems to be a typo.

## Statement
f 2 (3 * n ^ 2 + 3 * n + 1) = 9 * n ^ 2 + 3 * n

## Strategic notes
Open conjecture — prove-or-refute posture applies to sub-claims,
but the root asserts the conjectured statement itself. No
per-problem hints (benchmark integrity).
